description: List memory metadata with pagination and governance limits.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier (canonical or alias). Used only when scope="agent" or scope is inferred.

limit.description: Maximum memory metadata rows to return. Hard-capped: default 5, max 10. Values above 10 are silently reduced to 10.

scope.description: Explicit memory scope. "agent" (default, fail-closed) = lists memories for the given agent_id (or the token agent). "tenant" = lists memories across all agents of the authenticated tenant.

subject.description: ESCOPO1 (optional): opaque 8-128 char token ([A-Za-z0-9._:-]) that isolates memory to a single person within a shared connect-token. Omit for token-scoped behavior. Never include PII/email.

name: list_memories
